available_variables.label: Surface Soil Wetness (0-5 cm, GWETTOP)
available_variables.plain_definition: MERRA-2 modeled moisture saturation in the top 5 cm of soil (from 0 completely water-free to 1 fully saturated).

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg MERRA-2 sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of 3x3 box-spanning NASA POWER grid points

limitations: Regional 0.5 deg environmental context ONLY: broad box means do not rule out localized drought and do NOT directly observe cratering, landmines, or soil contamination.

available_variables.label: Root-Zone Soil Wetness (0-100 cm, GWETROOT)
available_variables.plain_definition: MERRA-2 modeled moisture saturation across the 0-1 m plant root zone (from 0 water-free to 1 fully saturated), tracking crop water reserves.

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg MERRA-2 sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of 3x3 box-spanning NASA POWER grid points

limitations: 0.5 deg reanalysis soil moisture context; cannot resolve farm-level soil disruption or war land degradation.

available_variables.label: Full-Profile Soil Wetness (GWETPROF)
available_variables.plain_definition: MERRA-2 modeled water saturation across the full vertical soil column to bedrock, changing more slowly across seasons than surface soil.

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg MERRA-2 sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of 3x3 box-spanning NASA POWER grid points

limitations: 0.5 deg deep soil moisture context; seasonal box means do not establish or rule out localized agricultural stress.

available_variables.label: Earth Skin Surface Temperature (TS)
available_variables.plain_definition: Modeled radiometric skin temperature of the ground surface itself, rising relative to air temperature when soils dry out.

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg MERRA-2 sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of 3x3 box-spanning NASA POWER grid points

uncertainty_and_status.pct_change_withheld_reason: Interval-scale or signed quantity crossing zero; report abs_diff instead of % change.

limitations: Interval-scale °C unit: relative % change is strictly withheld (null); use abs_diff (°C).
Coarse 0.5 deg thermal context only; cannot produce sub-kilometer land-surface temperature heatmaps.

available_variables.label: Surface-minus-Air Temperature Difference (Ts - T2m)
available_variables.plain_definition: 24-hour monthly mean temperature difference between the modeled ground skin and air 2 meters above it (-1.4 to +2.0 °C across study boxes), reflecting surface heating versus evaporative cooling.

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg MERRA-2 derived over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice

uncertainty_and_status.pct_change_withheld_reason: Interval-scale or signed quantity crossing zero; report abs_diff instead of % change.

limitations: Signed difference near zero: relative % change is strictly withheld (null).

available_variables.label: All-Sky Surface Albedo
available_variables.plain_definition: Fraction of incoming sunlight reflected off the land surface back into space, varying with winter snow, bare soil, and crop greenness.

spatial_support.resolution: 1.0 deg CERES sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of 3x3 box-spanning NASA POWER grid points

limitations: Coarse 1.0 deg surface reflectance indicator; snow cover, cloudiness, and regional crop phenology dominate box averages.
